changes.before: Create one more Counter before printing, leaving the Score assignments unchanged. What prints?
changes.after: Separate each object's score from a shared creation count.

before: An ordinary field belongs to one object. first.Score and second.Score can therefore differ.
A static field belongs to the type rather than each instance. Use Counter.Created to read it. Creating another Counter does not make a separate Created field.
The constructor increases the shared Created count each time an object is created. This small sequential example does not make the shared update thread-safe.
Expected behavior from this example: 0 then 2. This expected result is a reasoned prediction until a compiler test is recorded.

Optional local transfer task: Add another instance field for a label and compare it with the shared Created count. Use a .NET 10 console project with C# 14; reading completion does not verify this local work.
after: An instance field belongs to one object. Each Counter has its own Score, so changing first.Score does not change second.Score.
A static field belongs to the type. Counter.Created is one shared count, rather than a separate field in every Counter.
The constructor adds one to Created each time a Counter is made. Creating an object adds to the same count.
The program prints 0, then 2. second keeps its own starting score. Two constructor calls have increased the shared Created count twice.
This example creates objects one after another. If separate tasks update a shared value at the same time, their changes need extra protection. A later lesson covers that problem.

before.question: Create one more Counter before printing, leaving the Score assignments unchanged. What prints?
before.explanation: The third construction increases the one shared static count to 3. second.Score is still its own unchanged instance field.

after.question: Create a third Counter before printing. Keep the Score assignment unchanged. What prints?
after.explanation: second.Score stays zero. The third object increases the shared Created count to 3.
